name: transcript-list
title: Transcript list
description: A synced transcript: each line with its timestamp, the spoken line highlighted, click to jump, and a search that marks the words it finds.
docs: Pass cues ({ start, end, speaker?, text }, seconds, from your own WebVTT parser), currentTime and onSeek. The line being spoken is highlighted and carries aria-current. While the media plays the list scrolls that line to a comfortable place, moving itself and never the page; if the reader scrolls it out of view, following stops and Jump to current appears, and it resumes when the line is back in view or the button is pressed. Timestamps are buttons that call onSeek(start); the text is plain, selectable text and clicking it seeks too, unless the click ended a selection. searchable (default true) adds a search that ignores case and accents, hides lines that do not match, marks the words that do and announces the count politely; defaultQuery and onQueryChange control it. A speaker name shows above each turn. autoScroll, maxHeight, locale and labels tune it.
